questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a professional network. What do you think is the main reason for this?
options: because it's only through networking that one can find job opportunities
as it highlights the significance of building relationships in the workplace
since having connections can lead to career advancement and new experiences
in order to get hired, a person needs to be well-connected
questions.answer: as it highlights the significance of building relationships in the workplace

questions.question: The company's decision to relocate its headquarters to another city was met with widespread criticism from employees and local authorities. What had been expected by most people?
options: that the move would be a success and bring in more revenue
the opposite, as many were concerned about job losses and economic impact
a thorough evaluation of the pros and cons before making such a significant decision
it would have no effect on them whatsoever
questions.answer: the opposite, as many were concerned about job losses and economic impact

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the conference, the keynote speaker had already finished their presentation. What was likely to be the reason for this?
options: because they had underestimated the length of the speech
since the audience had shown little interest in the topic
as the speaker's words were not engaging enough to keep people attentive
due to an unexpected technical issue with the audio system
questions.answer: due to an unexpected technical issue with the audio system

questions.question: The new policy on employee benefits has been met with resistance from some staff members, who claim it is unfair and will lead to increased costs for them. What do you think is the main argument against this policy?
options: that it is too restrictive and does not provide enough flexibility
as it fails to address the specific needs of each employee group
since it does not consider the long-term implications on company finances
in that it is a step back from previous benefits packages
questions.answer: since it does not consider the long-term implications on company finances

questions.question: The professor's statement, 'It is only when one has failed that they can truly appreciate the value of hard work and perseverance', is an example of which grammatical structure?
options: the subjunctive mood
a conditional sentence in the past perfect tense
an inversion for emphasis in a cleft sentence
an ellipsis to convey a sense of regret
questions.answer: an inversion for emphasis in a cleft sentence
